title: State and capture coverage
responsibility: Narrows scenarios to relevant states and judges whether each required recorded capture supports its bound revision.

inputs.name: reasonText.text
inputs.description: Recorded reason whose file-location wording should be simplified.

inputs.name: scenarioFor.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier whose applicable states are requested.

inputs.name: scenarioFor.units
inputs.description: Optional registry units, defaulting to an empty list, used to follow active consumers transitively.

inputs.name: captureUnbound.capture
inputs.description: Capture whose recorded build binding is checked.

inputs.name: captureUnbound.commit
inputs.description: Commit that the capture should support.

inputs.name: explorerState.judged
inputs.description: Scenario declaration, result, record and bound commit, or null when there is no result to judge.

inputs.name: explorerState.absent
inputs.description: Fallback standing and reason tuple. The standing is used when a required state lacks a judged result; its supplied reason text is not copied by this helper.

outputs.name: reasonText
outputs.description: Reason with matching in-file location phrases removed and other matching file paths replaced by a file.

outputs.name: scenarioFor
outputs.description: Scenario narrowed to states naming the unit directly, otherwise states naming a transitive consumer, otherwise the unchanged full scenario.

outputs.name: coverageWorst
outputs.description: Worst standing in failed, stale, missing, incomplete, passed order; inapplicable when none of those occurs.

outputs.name: captureUnbound
outputs.description: Reason when the capture names another revision or a screenshot/actual capture has no build stamp; null otherwise.

outputs.name: explorerState
outputs.description: State coverage with reasons and evidence slots. Inapplicable states stay exempt; other nonrequired declarations are incomplete. Required states must be recorded as required and include each declared evidence/kind/viewport slot with a passed, stored, correctly bound capture. Missing declarations and slots never count as passed.
